an7.27:1.1: Satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi . . .
an7.27:1.3: Katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
an7.27:1.4: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.27:2.1: Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū anattasaññaṃ bhāvessanti . . .
an7.27:3.1: vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhi yeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī ti. 1.
